nutrients.ref: Nutrition as taught in Cameroonian Home Economics (food science): classes of nutrients, composition, sources, functions, deficiencies, effects of heat; vitamins and minerals; dietary fibre (NSP)
nutrients.supports: Macronutrients and micronutrients; marasmus and kwashiorkor; gelatinisation, dextrinisation, caramelisation, coagulation; fat-soluble and water-soluble vitamins; iron, calcium, iodine, sodium, fluoride; hidden hunger; fibre sources and functions.
nutrients.checked: Standard textbook content, not externally sourced in this session: please check the examples and deficiency names.

food-energy.ref: Energy values of the macronutrients: carbohydrate and protein 4 kcal (17 kJ) per gram, fat 9 kcal (37 kJ) per gram

water-health.ref: Water in nutrition; water-borne diseases and their prevention (WHO water, sanitation and hygiene guidance)
water-health.supports: Sources and functions of water; dehydration; cholera, typhoid, dysentery, hepatitis A, bilharzia; ORS; boiling, filtering, chlorination, latrines, handwashing.
water-health.checked: General knowledge, not opened in this session: please check.

kitchens.ref: Traditional and modern kitchens, as in Form One Home Economics (TR-H01, TR-H02)
kitchens.supports: Traditional kitchen items, fuels and fireplaces; advantages, disadvantages and care; modern kitchen shapes, units, the work triangle (sides 1.2–2.7 m, total 4–7.9 m), planning points, time management and care. The drawings are the Form One ones (homeeconomics.js).
